LESSON: OBEDIENCE VALUES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: question(s) Christian 4.1 Sharing By the end of the Sub strand, the learner shou
Topic 4.2: Obedience values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Obedience values. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: why they should obey obey parents?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the importance of obedience to promote peace and harmony at home
2. demonstrate obedience by obeying parents and older siblings at home.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the importance of obedience to promote peace and harmony at home
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to describe the importance of obedience to promote peace and harmony at home. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate obedience by obeying parents and older siblings at home.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate obedience by obeying parents and older siblings at home. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Obedience values.
2. Explain Obedience values to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should read Ephesians 4:25 1.
4. Show that you can: describe the importance of obedience to promote peace and harmony at home
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Obedience values. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: why they should obey obey parents?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Ephesians 4:25 1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. describe the importance of obedience to promote peace and harmony at home
2. demonstrate obedience by obeying parents and older siblings at home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
